It’s official: The general election to represent Washington’s 3rd Congressional District has begun.
I’m Congresswoman Marie Gluesenkamp Perez, officially the Democratic Nominee for Congress, running in one of the closest districts in the country.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
If you’re with me, please help me kick off the general election by pitching in $50, $25, $10, or even just $1. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]
In 2024, I won this seat by less than four percentage points. Donald Trump carried the district by the same margin.
That makes me one of just a handful of members of Congress to win a House seat in a district carried by Trump.
Republicans cannot maintain control of the House if they don’t win here this November.
That’s why national Republicans, including Elon Musk, have announced plans to spend vast sums to defeat me.
This is the part where they try to overwhelm us: More money, more ads, more outside groups trying to define this race and buy themselves a House seat.
But I didn’t get into this to follow the rules of a rigged system. I’m not a career politician.
I’m an auto repair shop owner, a mom, and a wife who believes the people of Washington deserve a representative who actually understands work, struggle, and responsibility.
And I believe we can win this thing. But only if we don’t slow down now.
The general election starts now, and we have to hit the ground running. So I’m asking you: Can you pitch in to help us start this next phase strong? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]

Now that we’re officially in the general election, all eyes will be on this race. And we need to be ready for what’s coming.
Let’s show them that our district can’t be bought — it’s built by working people who are ready to stand up.
-Marie Gluesenkamp Perez

But I didn’t get into this to follow the rules of a rigged system. I’m not a career politician. I’m an auto repair shop owner, a mom, and a wife who believes the people of Washington deserve a representative who actually understands work, struggle, and responsibility. And I believe we can win this thing. But only if we don’t slow down now. The general election starts now, and we have to hit the ground running. So I’m asking you: Can you pitch in to help us start this next phase strong? [?] DONATE NOW [?] Now that we’re officially in the general election, all eyes will be on this race. And we need to be ready for what’s coming. Let’s show them that our district can’t be bought — it’s built by working people who are ready to stand up. -Marie Gluesenkamp Perez Marie for Congress PO Box 1164 Washougal, WA 98671 United States If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: .

name: Mark Kelly
subject: My decision...
body:
Hey folks,
it’s Mark Kelly.

Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run
for the Senate.

I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of
time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.

But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing
just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I
had to do something.

So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run
all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support,
we won that one, too.

I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and
defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the
greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be
here without your help.

I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different.
With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have
ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.

After everything that’s already happened, I wish I didn’t have to ask you
for more. But that’s what I need to do.

Chris Pappas needs your help. I just hope you know that I wouldn’t be
asking if this wasn’t important.

Thank you.

Mark

# Tomorrow I'll Share My Vision for Maryland. Will you join me?
Friend,
There are still tickets available and you may pay at the gate tomorrow at the [Picnic Under the Tent event from 4pm-7pm](https://us.list-manage.com/e3m2ZJyQKRe?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b).

Would you spare a few moments with me for the sake of our beautiful State of Maryland?

I'd love to see you there, give you **an inside report** on our recent trip to the Republican Governor's Association meeting with our nation's top Governors, and how we will win Maryland and renew opportunity here for our children, families, businesses and retirees alike.

Great food, drinks and fellowship! Click the [link here](https://us.list-manage.com/h8Y3Pv7Mys0?e=5bb5efcda7&c2id=56a77d5a7be3731f6f21d9e4cc6a323b) or see us there to pay at the gate. A HUGE thank you to Dr. Jim and Marianne Pelura for opening their farm to everyone and hosting this amazing, real Maryland event.

See you there tomorrow!

For Maryland,

Dan Cox
Republican Nominee for Governor of Maryland

The House passed the SAVE America Act three times. Senate Democrats have blocked it every single time.

| | | | Peter, For the third time, House Republicans passed the SAVE America Act -- legislation that requires voters to prove they are American citizens before casting a ballot in American elections. Voter ID. Proof of citizenship. The most basic, common-sense election integrity measure imaginable. They passed it three times. Every single House Republican voted for it. _Now it sits in the Senate. And Chuck Schumer is sharpening his knife._
